decision.section: Iterate — bug: one source for the unresolved-license count
decision.title: SBOM render owns the unresolved-license count
decision.context: The dashboard counted only the literal 'unknown' license and missed not-installed packages, so it showed 0 unresolved while sbom.md reported 8.
decision.decision: Add sbom_render.unresolved_count (declared-none plus not-installed); the SBOM generator and the Control Grade dependency line both call it. The dashboard's private set is removed.
decision.consequences: Both surfaces always show the same number; a test pins it on a fixture. Dependency-hygiene scores may drop for repos with uninstalled dependencies.
decision.rationale: One definition next to _classify cannot drift; the SBOM is the documented source of truth.
decision.rejected: Keeping two counters and syncing them by test only: drift recurs on the next change.

changelog.bullet: fix(compliance): dashboard and SBOM now report the same unresolved-license count, including dependencies that could not be resolved in the scan

behaviors.behavior: dashboard unresolved-license count equals the SBOM's count on a fixture with unknown and not-installed licenses
unresolved_count is the SBOM definition (declared-none plus not-installed; empty is 0)

finalize.reason: iterate: one source for the unresolved-license count

event_extras.description: dashboard and SBOM share one unresolved-license count
event_extras.summary: The dashboard now shows the same number of unresolved licenses as the SBOM instead of undercounting dependencies it could not resolve.
event_extras.spec_impact_justification: Restores the documented behaviour that the dashboard and SBOM agree on unresolved licenses; no requirement changes.

affected_acs.why: Compliance evidence stays generated from the same data; only the dashboard count source changed.
